items.title: CSAW'25 Hack My Robot Competition - 2nd Place
items.role: Team Smooth Operators - NYU Abu Dhabi
items.description: Selected among 5 finalists in MENA region and won 2nd place. Our project "From Clicks to Collision: A Cyber-Physical Kill Chain" demonstrated a multi-phase cyber attack on Robot Operating Systems (ROS), showing how a remote attacker could progress from network breach to system infiltration and operational sabotage, causing robot malfunction.
